{{Top|leg}}
[[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] manufactured a '''multi-socket computer interface''' for use in their [[GY-I information analysis droid]]. The hardware was capable of accessing most [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
